verdict.rationale: Loops says segments are dynamic and stay current as contact properties change, and its marketing-email page lists building an audience segment, so attribute-based live segmentation is covered. Events are documented only as workflow triggers, not as segment criteria, and tags are never mentioned. One user's wish for "better filtering" hints the segmentation tooling is basic. Missing for 10: evidence of segmenting on behavioral events, tag-based segmentation, detailed segment-builder documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration.
